name: Fix: Victorian Century - Chinese Labor Agreement Event Disabled
short_description: Victorian Century's China event joi_flavor_chi.29 ('Labor Contract with China', triggered from a topbar button available to several colonial powers) creates migrant pops with Standard of Living 100 -- wrecking the receiving state's economy every playthrough, around year 4. An explicit pop_type on the created pops did not fix it (tested in-game). Disables the event's game effects entirely -- the popup and its two options still show, but neither creates pops, migration, or modifiers anymore. Load after Victorian Century.
